_note: The seven paper-doll gear slots (DOM-121), in display order, with the labels screens print. These keys are the `slot` field on every data/gear.json row and the keys of G.loadout — do not rename one without a save migration. DOM-116 (Store) reads the labels for its `{SLOT} · {buff}` meta line; DOM-130 (Profile GEAR tab) reads the same map rather than carrying a second copy. `body` marks the five worn slots, as opposed to RIDE and STASH.
